meta.name: CCNL Istituti e Imprese di Vigilanza Privata e Servizi Fiduciari — ASSIV/ANIVP/UNIV (Servizi fiduciari)

family.reason: Private security and fiduciary services (ASSIV), servizi fiduciari section.

notes.text: CCNL HV17 (ASSIV/ANIVP/UNIV with FILCAMS/FISASCAT/UILTUCS), Servizi Fiduciari section. Conglobated, divisor 173. 5 levels (A-E). 14a mensilita from 01/01/2024; before that 13 months. 8 tranches, last at 01/04/2026 (SF schedule). Level F absent from tables (may be entry/apprenticeship only; verify base CCNL 2013).

SENIORITY (Parte servizi fiduciari Art. 25, CCNL 2013, PDF p. 117): six triennial increments, A 21, B 19, C 17, D 15 EUR from February 2018, none for level E; unchanged by the ipotesi of 30 May 2023. The earlier amounts (29/26/22/19/17.50) and maximum of 10 came from no HV17 text.
APPRENTICESHIP: modelled as 100% of the destination level. The art. 86 quoted before is of the FEDERDAT CCNL (CNEL HV51), not of this one; the apprenticeship clause of HV17 was not read.

limitation.remediation: Read the apprenticeship clause of the HV17 text for the servizi fiduciari and model its track.

notes.text: ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 for Jun 2023-Dec 2023 (pre-quattordicesima); 14 from 01/01/2024 onward (quattordicesima introduced by rinnovo July 2023 renewal, per fiscoetasse.com). Level E: entry-level for first 9 months of tenure per contract text — correct by design.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: CNEL archive of HV17 and HV51; CCNL 8 April 2013 Parte servizi fiduciari Art. 25 (PDF p. 117, page image); ipotesi 30 May 2023 (OCR, 43 pages); UILTUCS tables of 16 February 2024 (no seniority figures).
findings: The file holds the HV17 pay tables (A-E 2023-2026 match the accordo of 16 February 2024), not those of FEDERDAT (HV51): renamed vigilanza-privata-assiv-sf, signatories of HV17.
Seniority: six triennial increments A 21, B 19, C 17, D 15, E none; the file had 29/26/22/19/17.50 and a maximum of 10 with no HV17 source.
The apprenticeship note quoted the FEDERDAT text: recorded as an open limitation.

reviews.scope: Paga conglobata of levels A-E against the signed tables of 16 February 2024, page 2, read on the page image.
findings: Every level was shifted one column: the amount of 1/01/24 was dated 1/06/23, and so on; the December 2026 tranche was missing. Nine periods rebuilt on the printed dates 01/06/23 ... 01/12/26 (an independent reading and a separate investigation agreed).
